denominator_contract: Every id in required_case_ids must exist in testdata/ddl-golden/T08.json or in a named unit/e2e test. Removing a case, loosening an expectation, or shrinking the denominator without amending this file is a contract violation. Role ids frozen to golden-runner namespaces T08.cli/T08.clierr/T08.meta (previously written T08.db.<anchor>.<role>). err.cancel and err.policy-invalid are admission-bound to named unit tests; err.unsupported-aspect to the T08.cli.unsupported-aspect golden case. The manifest additionally binds the 8 baseline db and 2 baseline cli roles for anchor health. err.syntax is admitted as the T08.cli.err-syntax golden case (parse failures emit a result JSON, so it is a cli case not a clierr case); err.policy-invalid is admitted as T08.clierr.err-policy-invalid (missing policy config exits before any audit result); err.cancel remains a named unit-test role.

native_roles.N-omit: MODIFY omitting NULL/DEFAULT on c INT NULL DEFAULT 0 — effective IS_NULLABLE + COLUMN_DEFAULT, 4 anchors; also CHANGE variant
native_roles.N-omit-ai: MODIFY omitting AUTO_INCREMENT — effective EXTRA, 4 anchors
native_roles.N-setter: SET DEFAULT literal/NULL/'NULL'/'' + DROP DEFAULT catalog facts, 4 anchors
native_roles.N-pos: ADD FIRST / AFTER known / AFTER missing / MODIFY FIRST / CHANGE AFTER — ORDINAL_POSITION sets + error classes, 4 anchors
native_roles.N-multi: independent adds; mixed add+setter; sibling position ref (doc-proven TiDB pre-state split); same-object twice; drop+re-add — 4 anchors
native_roles.N-pk: MODIFY pk INT [NULL] on PK member — accept/coerce/error per anchor
native_roles.N-default-kind: COLUMN_DEFAULT raw+HEX distinguishes authored DEFAULT 'NULL' from SQL NULL vs omitted — A4 boundary record
